messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org 'riptide' (org_id=7621) exceeding org_qps_threshold — current ~420 qps (limit 100). Error rate rising; 5xx spike. Paging oncall.

maria_oncall: I'm on it — Pulling traces and token-level metrics now.

ben_infra: seeing KV cache pressure + long running prompts from their checkout flow. My read: retry storm from downstream failures amplifying traffic. Recommend temporary qps bump + route downgrade for non-critical endpoints.

maria_oncall: Plan: 1) temp qps bump to 300 for 60m 2) enable model-small fallback for non-checkout routes 3) notify customer + finance. Starting quick mitigation.

maria_oncall: Executing admin API patch now.

maria_oncall: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.internal.redwood/v1/admin/orgs/7621/rate_limit" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"qps":300,"duration_minutes":60,"scope":"org","note":"emergency checkout surge"}'
```

incident-bot: Action queued: change_request_8812 created (author: maria_oncall). Awaiting infra approval.

ben_infra: Approving change_request_8812 from infra side. :white_check_mark:

maria_oncall: Change accepted and applied — rate limit updated to 300 qps. Observability: 503s down ~80% on affected endpoints, latency improving.

leo_support: Messaging customer in #support-riptide: "Applied temporary throughput increase while we investigate. We're tracking root cause and will follow up with next steps and any billing impacts."

tanya_account: Thanks — looping in account team. Please include expected rollback ETA (default 60m) and estimated overage exposure for finance.

sam_engineer: We traced spike to a batch worker retry loop after a downstream payment gateway degraded. Client-side backoff missing. Recommending hotfix on their side to reduce retry concurrency + our temporary fallback is reducing amplified load.

maria_oncall: Noted. I'll keep the bump for 55m and then auto-rollback to 100 qps unless we escalate. Creating incident record IR-2026-047 and assigning postmortem.

ops-runner: Added postmortem task, assigned to eng-infra. Will schedule triage tomorrow. :memo:
